parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

😎
bankrupt[bæŋkrʌpt]adj.
If someone is bankrupt, then they are unable to pay their debts.
→ The store had few customers and soon went bankrupt.
😎
conform[kənfɔ:rm]v.
To conform to rules or laws is to obey them.
→ The new student had to conform to the school’s dress code.
😎
employ[implɔi]v.
To employ someone means to give work to them.
→ The bookstore employed two full-time clerks.
😎
expel[ikspel]v.
To expel someone means to force them to leave a place.
→ Since he would not follow the rules, the principal had to expel the student.
😎
extension[ikstenʃən]n.
An extension is a part added to something to give it more time or space.
→ My parents decided to add an extension to our house for the new baby.
😎
forthcoming[fɔ:rθkʌmiŋ]adj.
If something is forthcoming, then it is about to happen in the future.
→ Some economists predicted that the forthcoming world economy would be severe.
😎
furnish[fə:rniʃ]v.
To furnish means to put furniture in a house or room.
→ Most homes are furnished with tables, chairs, and beds.
😎
hygiene[haidʒi:n]n.
Hygiene is the conditions or methods needed for health and cleanliness.
→ People who brush their teeth at least twice a day are practicing good hygiene.
😎
hygienic[haidʒi:nik]adj.
If something is hygienic, then it is clean and unlikely to cause disease.
→ My sister works very hard to keep her entire home as hygienic as possible.
😎
landlord[lændlɔ:rd]n.
A landlord is a man who rents property to a person.
→ The landlord collected everyone’s rent money on the first day of every month.
😎
lease[li:s]v.
To lease means to rent property, usually an apartment or land.
→ When the family first leased the apartment, the rent was very low.
😎
mandatory[mændətɔ:ri]adj.
If something is mandatory, then it is required by law.
→ It’s mandatory that everyone be at least sixteen to drive a car in the US.
😎
mend[mend]v.
To mend something means to fix it when it is broken or damaged.
→ Mother mended the rip in my pants with a piece of cloth.
😎
mortgage[mɔ:rgidʒ]n.
A mortgage is a loan for property, especially homes and businesses.
→ When they bought their new home, the married couple had to sign a mortgage.
😎
personnel[pə:rsənel]n.
Personnel are employees in a business.
→ When business increased, we had to hire more personnel.
😎
plumbing[plʌmiŋ]n.
Plumbing is the system of pipes used in a home to supply water.
→ When the plumbing stopped working, no one was allowed to use the toilets.
😎
tenant[tenənt]n.
A tenant is a person who rents property from a landlord.
→ The new tenants moved into the house across the street.
😎
trendy[trendi]adj.
If something is trendy, then it is very popular and new.
→ Carlo bought a trendy new car.
😎
utility[ju:tiləti]n.
A utility is a business that supplies services such as water or electricity.
→ If you don’t pay the utilities, you may have your electricity turned off.
😎
whereby[hwɛərbai]conj.
Whereby means by which or through which.
→ The mayor had a new bridge built whereby the citizens could cross the river.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Choose the answer that best fits the question.

questions.content: 1. Which of the following means the closest to mend?
questions.explanation: Mend là sửa chữa. Đồng nghĩa với repair.

questions.content: 2. Which of following would NOT be considered part of an office’s personnel?
questions.explanation: Personnel là nhân viên trong tổ chức văn phòng. Trọng tài (Referees) không thuộc nhân sự văn phòng.

questions.content: 3. Plumbing involves work on_______ in a house or building.
questions.explanation: Plumbing là hệ thống cấp nước, liên quan đến các đường ống nước (water pipes).

questions.content: 4. If something is trendy, then it is______ .
questions.explanation: Trendy là hợp thời trang, phổ biến. Đồng nghĩa với in style (thịnh hành).

questions.content: 5. Which is NOT considered a utility?
questions.explanation: Utility là dịch vụ tiện ích như điện, nước, khí đốt. Dịch vụ phòng (Room service) không phải là tiện ích công cộng.

sections.title: Exercise 2: Write a word that is similar in meaning to the underlined part.

questions.content: 1. His company gives work to about 100 people in the community. (app[1])
2. Joan was forced to leave from the auditorium for her hostile comments. (app[1])
3. My new apartment in the city was complete with bed, sofa, and TV. (app[1])
4. The prisoner’s condition for health and cleanliness was absolutely terrible. (app[1])
5. I’m going to rent the apartment for only six months. (app[1])
6. I need to fix the hole in my pants. (app[1])
7. He was lucky to find employees who are honest and hardworking. (app[1])
8. We need to have our system of pipes that brings water into our house checked. (app[1])
9. The popular and new fashion these days for men is boots. (app[1])
10. Did you remember to pay the company that provides our water? (app[1])

sections.title: Exercise 3: Write C if the italicized word is used correctly. Write I if the word is used incorrectly.

questions.content: 1. The sharp rocks mended his jeans into pieces.
questions.explanation: Mend là sửa chữa. Những hòn đá sắc nhọn không thể "sửa chữa" chiếc quần thành từng mảnh được. Sai (I).

questions.content: 2. The school sent a second bus whereby the students could get to school.
questions.explanation: Whereby nghĩa là nhờ đó, qua đó. Đúng (C).

questions.content: 3. He had poor hygiene. He never washed his hands or brushed his teeth.
questions.explanation: Hygiene là vệ sinh cá nhân. Không rửa tay, không đánh răng là poor hygiene. Đúng (C).

questions.content: 4. The dam on the lake became bankrupt, and soon water broke through the cracks.
questions.explanation: Bankrupt là phá sản (về mặt tài chính). Con đập không thể phá sản được. Sai (I).

questions.content: 5. The restaurant was a trendy place where all the rich and famous people went.
questions.explanation: Trendy là hợp thời, nổi tiếng. Nhà hàng là một nơi thịnh hành thu hút người nổi tiếng. Đúng (C).

questions.content: 6. The first three cars to finish were given an award, but the forthcoming car got nothing.
questions.explanation: Forthcoming là sắp tới (tương lai). Không dùng cho chiếc xe xếp thứ 4 (fourth). Từ đồng âm bị nhầm lẫn. Sai (I).

questions.content: 7. She made a mistake and accidentally walked into the mandatory bathroom.
questions.explanation: Mandatory là bắt buộc theo luật. Phòng tắm không thể là phòng bắt buộc theo luật. Sai (I).

questions.content: 8. After he furnished dinner, the host gave him some dessert.
questions.explanation: Furnish là trang bị đồ đạc nội thất. Không thể nói là trang bị bữa tối. Phải dùng từ finish. Sai (I).

questions.content: 9. Rather than conforming to one religion, Mary chose what she liked from all of them.
questions.explanation: Conform là tuân theo. Mary không tuân theo một tôn giáo nào mà tự chọn những gì cô ấy thích. Đúng (C).

questions.content: 10. I knew something was wrong with the plumbing once the hot water stopped working.
questions.explanation: Plumbing là hệ thống ống nước. Nước nóng ngưng chảy báo hiệu hệ thống ống nước có vấn đề. Đúng (C).

questions.content: 11. She graduated from university where she studied utility.
questions.explanation: Utility là các tiện ích công cộng. Không phải là một chuyên ngành học chính ở đại học. Sai (I).

questions.content: 12. Because of an error, the game was given an extension of five more minutes.
questions.explanation: Extension là sự gia hạn. Trận đấu được gia hạn thêm 5 phút. Đúng (C).

questions.content: 13. He’s very hygienic because he bathes once a week and seldom changes his clothes.
questions.explanation: Hygienic là hợp vệ sinh, sạch sẽ. Tắm mỗi tuần một lần và hiếm khi thay đồ thì không thể gọi là hygienic. Sai (I).

questions.content: 14. The landlord owned several buildings throughout the capital city.
questions.explanation: Landlord là chủ đất/chủ nhà. Đúng (C).

questions.content: 15. The factory needed more workers. It had to employ twenty more people.
questions.explanation: Employ là thuê người làm. Đúng (C).

questions.content: 16. Tom didn’t want to talk about his father’s new job. He thought it was too personnel.
questions.explanation: Nên dùng personal (cá nhân), không phải personnel (nhân sự). Sai (I).

questions.content: 17. There was too much sugar in the recipe, so she leased the amount with a spoon.
questions.explanation: Lease là cho thuê tài sản. Ở đây muốn nói đến từ lessened (giảm bớt), dùng từ lease là sai. Sai (I).

questions.content: 18. Because the rent was so expensive, all of the tenants are probably wealthy people.
questions.explanation: Tenants là những người thuê nhà. Đúng (C).

questions.content: 19. They were expelled from the restaurant because they couldn’t pay their bill.
questions.explanation: Expel là bị đuổi ra. Họ bị đuổi khỏi nhà hàng vì không trả tiền. Đúng (C).

questions.content: 20. In order to buy a house, most people have to get a mortgage.
questions.explanation: Mortgage là khoản vay thế chấp. Để mua nhà thì phải vay thế chấp là đúng. Đúng (C).

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
The Resourceful Landlord

A kind landlord was afraid that he would lose his apartment building. He needed to make some mandatory repairs to the old building, or his tenants would have to leave by the end of the month. Without tenants to lease the rooms, the landlord would be unable to pay his mortgage. He’d be bankrupt, and the bank would take his building.

But he didn’t have the money whereby he could employ the personnel needed to make the repairs. It would seem like he did not want to conform to the city’s codes before the forthcoming inspection. He had requested an extension, but it was denied by the city.

He held a meeting with his tenants and explained the unfortunate situation. “If the building does not meet the appropriate standards for safety and hygiene,” he said, “the city will expel everyone.”

The tenants were all sad for the kind old man.

“Maybe we can help,” the hairdresser who lived on the first floor stated. The other tenants agreed.

One tenant had worked for the city’s utilities. He knew a lot about plumbing, so that’s how he helped. Another tenant was a carpenter; he mended the holes in the floor and walls. Others cleaned the building from top to bottom so that it was more hygienic. They even furnished some of the apartments with new beds, dressers, and chairs. When they were done, all of the people dispersed, and the landlord went home to rest.

When the deadline of the inspection arrived, the apartment building was hygienic and safe. The landlord couldn’t believe it. His old building now looked like one of the trendiest buildings in town.

The building passed its inspection, and the landlord and the tenants had a big party.

“Thank you all so much,” the landlord said during the party. “I could never have done it by myself. But by working together, we now all have a beautiful place to live.”

sections.title: Part A: Mark each statement T for true or F for false. Rewrite the false statements to make them true.

questions.content: 1. If the tenants didn’t pay the mortgage, the landlord could not pay his lease and would be bankrupt.
questions.explanation: Sai. Nếu những người thuê nhà không trả tiền thuê nhà (lease), chủ nhà sẽ không thể trả tiền vay mua nhà thế chấp (mortgage) và sẽ bị phá sản.

questions.content: 2. The landlord did not have money whereby he could employ personnel.
questions.explanation: Đúng. Chủ nhà không có tiền để có thể thuê nhân công (nhân sự) tiến hành sửa chữa.

questions.content: 3. The city would expel everyone if the building did not pass the inspection for safety and hygiene.
questions.explanation: Đúng. Thành phố sẽ trục xuất (đuổi) mọi người ra khỏi đó nếu tòa nhà không vượt qua buổi kiểm tra an toàn và vệ sinh.

questions.content: 4. The hairdresser mended the holes in the floors and walls.
questions.explanation: Sai. Người thợ mộc (carpenter) là người vá các lỗ trên sàn và tường chứ không phải thợ cắt tóc.

questions.content: 5. After everyone helped to fix it, the building looked like one of the trendiest buildings in town.
questions.explanation: Đúng. Sau khi sửa xong, tòa nhà trông giống như một trong những nơi thời thượng (trendy) nhất thị trấn.

questions.content: 1. In addition to dressers, what did the tenants furnish some of the apartments with?
questions.explanation: Dựa vào văn bản: "They even furnished some of the apartments with new beds, dressers, and chairs."

questions.content: 2. If the landlord did not conform to the city’s mandatory hygienic standards, what would happen to the tenants?
options: His tenants would have to leave by the end of the month.
His tenants would have to pay a fine.
His tenants would go to jail.
His tenants would buy the building.
questions.explanation: Nếu chủ nhà không tuân thủ quy định bắt buộc, người thuê sẽ phải rời đi vào cuối tháng (his tenants would have to leave by the end of the month).

questions.content: 3. What happened to the landlord’s request for an extension to the forthcoming deadline?
options: He had requested an extension, but the city denied it.
He forgot to submit the request.
questions.explanation: Dựa vào văn bản: "He had requested an extension, but it was denied by the city."

questions.content: 4. What did the tenant who had worked for the city’s utilities do to the building’s plumbing?
options: He charged the landlord for the plumbing repairs.
questions.explanation: Người đã từng làm việc ở công ty tiện ích thành phố biết nhiều về hệ thống ống nước và đã sửa ống nước.

questions.content: 5. What did the landlord do after all of the people dispersed?
options: He went to the city office to complain.
He threw a party right away.
He went to sleep in the lobby.
questions.explanation: Dựa vào văn bản: "When they were done, all of the people dispersed, and the landlord went home to rest."
